title: crotalaria iodina
intro: Crotalaria iodina, commonly known as Iodine Bush or Iodine Weed, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Crotalaria iodina include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-tumor properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
